assumption: Worlds are fixed or procedurally generated; no engine lets the environment itself be selected or co-evolved with its organisms.
detection_basis: atlas.ecosystem: all four Prometheus rows have environment_generation in (fixed, procedural); 26 catalogued external systems have co-evolved, 9 learned, 8 LLM-generated.
anti_experiment: UED-1/UED-4 run the same population under co-evolutionary environment laws; the anti-prior version hands the world's parameters to the organisms themselves.

assumption: The interpreter and the copy machinery are outside the heritable unit: organisms vary, the machine that runs them does not.
detection_basis: Every Prometheus organism representation in atlas.ecosystem is a genome executed by a fixed VM (machine_code, tree/tape genome, graph organism, policy); no row records mutable_interpreter.
anti_experiment: AL-1: fixed vs mutable interpreter with matched mutation rate and viability, scored on the reachability SET rather than time-to-solution.

assumption: The unit that reproduces, competes, inherits and is measured is one discrete organism with a fixed boundary.
detection_basis: No Prometheus substrate permits an evolvable organism boundary (catalogue matrix, 2026-09-19); every lineage record in atlas.edge assumes parent-child identity between single organisms.
anti_experiment: TI-1 and AL-3: let the reproducing, competing, inheriting and measured units differ, with an entity detector validated on synthetic positives and negatives.

assumption: Every engine carries an explicit fitness term, even when it also uses quality-diversity or novelty.
detection_basis: All four Prometheus rows list explicit_fitness among pressure_kinds; 90 catalogued systems select by implicit replication alone.
anti_experiment: XE-07 / AL-5: the same substrate under implicit replication only, with no scalar objective anywhere in the loop.

assumption: Competence means performance on a held-out task set defined by us before the run.
detection_basis: Primary observables across indexed campaigns are held-out competence, pass/fail fixtures or disposition words; no campaign's primary endpoint is an unnamed behaviour class discovered after the fact.
anti_experiment: F5-6 / RA-2: score a run by the rate at which NEW behaviour classes appear under descriptors fitted after the run, with a synthetic positive control.

assumption: Memory belongs to the organism and the world is a separate, mostly non-writable object.
detection_basis: No indexed Prometheus experiment records environmental_feedback as a primitive in use: worlds are read, scored and reset, not written into and inherited.
anti_experiment: A world whose substrate IS the memory: organisms persist only by writing into a shared medium that later organisms read, with a matched arm where writes are private.

assumption: Replication detectors assume an individual parent and an individual child, so anything that propagates without that shape is invisible.
detection_basis: Nestor's S1-C re-adjudication turned on parent-child attribution: 6,287 of 6,547 recombination-axis events were splice artefacts rather than parent-to-child copies.
anti_experiment: Score propagation with a detector that needs no parent-child pair (population-level information transmission), run on the SAME logs, and compare what each detector sees.
